About the Scholarship

The Karsh International Scholars Program is Duke University's flagship merit award for international undergraduates, recognising academic leaders from around the world. International applicants to Duke are automatically considered, and the regular decision application round closes in early January 2027.

The Karsh International Scholars Program is Duke University's flagship merit award for international undergraduates, recognising academic leaders from around the world. International applicants to Duke are automatically considered, and the regular decision application round closes in early January 2027.

Programme Highlights

  • Full four-year support for international students at Duke
  • Automatic consideration with the admission application
  • Summer research and civic-engagement funding for scholars
  • Community of Karsh scholars across all majors

Who Should Apply

International first-year applicants with exceptional academic records and leadership, applying to Duke by the regular decision deadline.

Funding and Costs

Full demonstrated need met for four years (tuition, room, board and fees) plus summer funding opportunities for Karsh scholars.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply to Duke through Common App or Coalition by the regular decision deadline; no separate Karsh form is required. Key deadline information: Considered automatically with the Duke admission application; regular decision closes in early January 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About Duke University

Duke University's Office of University Scholars and Fellows administers the Karsh International Scholars Program, the university's premier merit award for international undergraduates.

Official website: https://ousf.duke.edu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Considered automatically with the Duke - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
